prose:
Flavio Copes recounts a read-only Antigravity swarm audit split across links, images and build behavior with a verifier checking reports. The useful event in the account is a reviewer catching inaccurate findings before the final summary, rather than parallel activity alone.

This is a single author's repository case, not a controlled speed or quality benchmark. The article distinguishes the selected planner from workers shown using Hydrogen and says extra quota is worthwhile only for separable work. Model menus, commands and example prompts were not tested or executed here, and do not establish availability on every plan or account.
highlights: Planner choice and worker model differ
Author prefers a single workflow for ordinary edits
No general swarm superiority is proven
No product command or account was used
